result.summary: The residential intersection lacks essential pedestrian infrastructure, including marked crosswalks, curb ramps, and adequate signage. Significant visual obstructions from overgrown vegetation at the corner and poor pavement conditions further compromise pedestrian safety.

hazards.name: Unmarked Intersection
hazards.description: The lack of marked crosswalks and stop signs creates an environment where pedestrian right-of-way is not clearly defined.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the intersection

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Dense bushes at the corner block visibility between drivers and pedestrians approaching the intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Center-right corner near the yellow house

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Extensive cracking and uneven road surfaces create potential trip hazards for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and throughout the roadway

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian crossing areas.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install sloped curb ramps with detectable warnings at all intersection corners to ensure accessibility.

interventions.title: Daylighting and Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Trim or remove overgrown vegetation at the corner to restore clear sight triangles for all road users.

interventions.title: Traffic Control Signage
interventions.description: Install stop signs or yield signs to regulate vehicle movements at the currently uncontrolled intersection.

result.summary: This residential intersection features sidewalks but lacks essential pedestrian safety infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and curb ramps. The wide, unmarked roadway and lack of traffic control devices suggest a design that prioritizes vehicle flow over pedestrian accessibility and safety.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalks
hazards.description: No designated crossing area is provided, which fails to alert drivers to the presence of pedestrians at the intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the intersection in the foreground

hazards.name: Missing curb ramps
hazards.description: The lack of curb ramps at the sidewalk corner creates an accessibility barrier for individuals with mobility impairments or strollers.
hazards.location_in_image: At the corner of the sidewalk on the right side of the image

interventions.title: Install High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add painted crosswalks to clearly define the pedestrian path and increase driver awareness at the intersection.

interventions.title: Construct ADA-Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install ramps with detectable warning strips to ensure the intersection is accessible to all users.

result.summary: This residential intersection lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and curb ramps. While the low-traffic residential setting inherently reduces some risk, the degraded pavement and lack of formal crossing points create accessibility and safety challenges.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crosswalks
hazards.description: There are no painted markings to indicate where pedestrians should cross the intersection, increasing exposure to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground at the intersection

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Condition
hazards.description: The roadway surface is heavily cracked and degraded, which can cause tripping hazards or affect vehicle braking.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire foreground roadway

hazards.name: Missing Curb Ramps
hazards.description: The lack of ADA-compliant curb ramps makes the crossing inaccessible for people with mobility devices or strollers.
hazards.location_in_image: Corner of the sidewalk on the right

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicle
hazards.description: A large truck parked near the intersection may block sightlines between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the road near the intersection

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install tactile, sloped curb ramps at all intersection corners to ensure accessibility.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the intersection to improve sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Roadway Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair the cracked pavement to provide a smooth, safe surface for vehicles and pedestrians.

result.summary: The image shows a residential street with limited pedestrian infrastructure. While a sidewalk exists on one side, it is partially obstructed by vegetation and lacks a clear, continuous path or marked crossing points.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: A large flowering tree has low-hanging branches that partially block the sidewalk path on the right side of the image.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side, adjacent to the multi-story residential building

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks or signage to indicate where pedestrians should cross the wide roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground and mid-ground roadway

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb may block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians attempting to cross.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility continental crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance and Clearance
interventions.description: Prune overhanging vegetation to ensure a clear vertical and horizontal path for all users, including those with mobility devices.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at potential crossing points to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.
